def _json_safe(value: Any) -> Any:
 """Convert runtime receipts into JSON-safe values."""
 if isinstance(value, Path):
 return str(value)
 if isinstance(value, dict):
 return {str(key): _json_safe(item) for key, item in value.items()}
 if isinstance(value, list):
 return [_json_safe(item) for item in value]
 if isinstance(value, tuple):
 return [_json_safe(item) for item in value]
 if isinstance(value, set):
 return [_json_safe(item) for item in sorted(value)]
 return value


def _safe_phase(name: str, func: Callable[[], Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
 """Run one bootstrap phase and convert exceptions into status receipts."""
 started = time.time()
 try:
 result = func()
 if isinstance(result, dict):
 receipt = dict(result)
 else:
 receipt = {"status": "ok", "result": result}
 receipt.setdefault("status", "ok")
 receipt["phase"] = name
 receipt["duration_ms"] = int((time.time() - started) * 1000)
 return _json_safe(receipt)
 except Exception as exc:
 return {
 "status": "error",
 "phase": name,
 "error": str(exc),
 "duration_ms": int((time.time() - started) * 1000),
 }


def _overall_status(results: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
 """Compute aggregate bootstrap status from nested receipts."""
 good = {
 "ok",
 "healthy",
 "running",
 "already_running",
 "already_stopped",
 "installed",
 "succeeded",
 }
 degraded = {"degraded", "warn", "warning", "not_installed", "timeout"}
 bad = {"error", "failed", "down", "not_found"}

 statuses: list[str] = []

 def walk(value: Any) -> None:
 if isinstance(value, dict):
 status = value.get("status")
 if isinstance(status, str):
 statuses.append(status.lower())
 for child in value.values():
 walk(child)
 elif isinstance(value, list):
 for child in value:
 walk(child)

 walk(results)

 if any(status in bad for status in statuses):
 return "degraded"
 if any(status in degraded for status in statuses):
 return "degraded"
 if statuses and all(status in good for status in statuses):
 return "ok"
 return "ok"
